title: Protect owed closing source observations from completion after a named-root clear (durable unresolved-accounting barrier)
outcome: Protect owed closing source observations from completion after a named-root clear (durable unresolved-accounting barrier)
acceptance: An Engram architecture decision chooses between (a) a protected ordering in which the owed closing source observation is recorded before a named-root clear or release, and (b) an Engram-owned durable unresolved-accounting barrier that completion checks transactionally, and states the recovery contract when the barrier is set

The decision shows that a direct MCP/CLI `done` cannot consume a pre-move evaluation through decide_accounting_on's audit_only/root_basis_moved path while an owed closing observation is unresolved, and names the tests that would prove it

Any durable-format change is named and judged under the full-store migration rule and presented to Greg before implementation; the TermAl twin (TermAl w-dfb4bc61eabc) is linked and the host-protocol contract is agreed with TermAl
